title: The console file widget never uploads: it posts a browser blob object where the engine's `file` field wants a `sys_file` id string — `400 expected string, received object`
body:
Found in a browser dogfood pass on `objectstack-ai/hotclm` (hotclm#45), on `@objectstack/*` **17.4.0**. Filed at the destination per that repo's `AGENTS.md` — *report, never patch*. ⛔ Not triaged: no `domain:*`, no priority, no assignee.

Third of three independent defects each blocking the same action; siblings are #17264 (lookup param renders as a bare text box) and #17271 (dialog has no internal scroll, Submit unreachable).

## Symptom

A `Field.file` is filled through the console's file control and submitted:

```
POST /api/v1/data/clm_contract_version
→ 400  File has an invalid file value: Invalid input: expected string, received object
```

The widget hands the engine a **browser blob/File object**. The engine's contract is an **opaque `sys_file` id string**, minted by an upload.

**And no upload is ever attempted**: driving the control with a real `filechooser` produced **zero requests** on the wire. So the widget is not failing to upload — it never tries. There is no path from "user picked a file" to "a `sys_file` row exists".

## Why this is worse than a validation error

The two halves are both broken and they mask each other. Even if the payload shape were corrected client-side, there would be nothing to put in it, because no upload happened. A reader of the `400` naturally concludes the payload is wrong and goes looking for a serialisation bug; the real gap is a missing upload step.

⚠️ For a consuming app this closes a whole domain rather than one form. In `hotclm`, `clm_contract_version.file` is `required`, so **no contract version can be created through the UI at all** — and the app had already established (hotclm#19) that a declarative seed cannot mint a `sys_file` either. Between the two, that object has **no authoring path whatsoever**: not by seed, not by hand.

## Reproduce

```bash
git clone https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotclm && cd hotclm && pnpm install && pnpm demo
# sign in at /_console/, open a contract, add a version, attach any small file, save
# watch the network log: no upload request, then 400 on the data POST
```

## Expected

The control uploads the chosen bytes, receives the `sys_file` id, and submits **that string** — the same value the REST contract documents and a seed cannot produce. ⛔ Not claimed: whether the missing upload belongs to the widget, a service the widget should call, or a route that does not exist yet.

## Related

hotclm#45 (the dogfood pass) · #17264 · #17271 (the two sibling blockers on the same dialog) · hotclm#19 (the seed half of the same "no way to mint a `sys_file`" problem, still an open decision there)

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#17250
